title: Which Fantasy Quest Companion Are You?
description: Every legendary party needs six kinds of hero. When the quest calls, which one are you?

answers.text: Say the honest thing everyone's avoiding
Crack the joke that finally breaks the tension
Hear both sides out fully, no rushing
Give it space — some storms pass on their own

questions.text: How do you handle a disagreement between friends?

answers.text: Firefighter
Museum curator with keys to the archive
Undercover restaurant critic
Late-night talk show host

questions.text: Pick your dream job for a day:
Your packing style for a trip:

answers.text: Researched, listed, and packed days ahead
One bag, carry-on only, always
Half your bag is stuff others might forget
Light, practical, ready for any weather
Attacking the leader, openly and proudly
Winning quietly while everyone watches someone else
Making alliances you may or may not honor
Playing your own long game in the corner

questions.text: In a board game, you are:

answers.text: Push forward anyway — momentum fixes things
Pull out the backup plan you drafted quietly
Keep spirits high so nobody gives up
Make sure everyone's okay before regrouping

questions.text: The group's plan is falling apart. You:
Pick your spot at the campfire:

answers.text: Near the edge, where you can see everything
Dead center, mid-story, everyone leaning in
Next to whoever seems cold, sharing your blanket
Tending the fire itself

questions.text: A locked chest with no key. You:

answers.text: There's always the direct approach
Somewhere, there's a manual for this
Locks are just puzzles with attitude
Leave it. If it wanted opening, it'd be open.
Blunt, but exactly what you needed
Thorough. Possibly with sources.
Somehow a pep talk every time
Gentle, patient, and always kind
A book that answers one question per day
A coin that always wins the toss
A mirror that laughs at your jokes
Boots that never wear out
Charge to the summit anyway — you're already wet
Somehow you're the only one who stayed dry
Hand out the ponchos you packed for everyone
Read the clouds and call the safest route down

questions.text: It starts pouring rain mid-hike. You:

answers.text: Pick the loudest anthem and leave it all on stage
A niche song chosen for your exact vocal range
You have a signature song and it destroys every time
Duets only — you're there to make partners shine
Sleeping in past everyone
A long lunch with good company
Tea made properly, no shortcuts
The first quiet hour of the morning, outside

questions.text: How do you learn something new?

answers.text: Jump in and learn by losing a few rounds
Read everything first. Everything.
Find the tricks the tutorials don't teach
Trial, error, and patience — alone, thanks

questions.text: The quest is complete. Your reward of choice:

answers.text: The next quest
Access to the royal library
A feast where you retell the whole story
Everyone home safe. That was the reward.

results.description: The spark of every party and the glue of every group. You turn hard days into good stories, and good stories into legend. Adventures are simply better with you along.
The quiet strength of the party. You notice what everyone needs, give more than you take, and no one gets left behind on your watch. Every quest survives because of you.
Knowledge is your power source. Prepared, strategic, and quietly brilliant, you're the one with the plan — and the backup plan, footnoted. The party thinks because you do.
Self-reliant and sharp-eyed. You're at home where the path ends, comfortable with quiet, and somehow always know the way — even without a map.
Quick wit, quicker hands. You find the angle nobody else sees and slip through problems that stop everyone else cold — usually with a grin.
Head-on and whole-hearted. You face what others avoid, say what others won't, and shield the people you love without a second thought.
